pos: The person remains standing in the exact center of the frame for the whole shot, looking exactly as in the reference frames: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape. Feet planted on the ground, head level and still, with a slow, clearly visible natural breathing motion and a gentle shift of weight between the feet, shoulders and arms settling naturally toward the final reference pose. The facial expression is a calm, neutral, relaxed look that never changes: mouth softly closed, no smile, brows relaxed, eyes open and steady, looking directly at the camera. The camera is locked on a fixed tripod at a constant distance from the person: the distance never changes, the framing never changes, and the person's apparent size stays exactly the same from the first frame to the last, with no zoom-in, no zoom-out, no push-in, no pull-out, no dolly and no drift of any kind. The background is completely static and rock-steady: every wall, door, floor tile and object stays locked in its exact position with zero movement, zero wobble, zero shimmer and zero flicker for the entire shot, exactly matching the reference frames. The mouth stays completely closed for the entire shot: lips gently pressed together, jaw relaxed and motionless, teeth and tongue never visible. The person does not talk, does not speak, does not laugh out loud, does not yawn and never opens the mouth at any point; this is a silent, wordless pose transition only. The background stays exactly as in the reference frames: each element holding the same position, shape and brightness throughout, with no new objects and no environment changes. The lighting, brightness and colors match the reference frames exactly. The camera is locked off on a tripod: it holds the same angle, position and framing for the entire duration, with no pan, no zoom, no shake and no drift, keeping the person at exactly the same apparent size and distance. The only other movement is the smooth, gradual ease into the exact pose of the final reference frame.

_comment: 2026-11-13：从 ltx_transition_neutral 派生。neutral 要求「几乎察觉不到的呼吸」，25 帧生成出来接近静止（逐帧差 0.2~0.4），姿势变化被压到最后一帧突变——用户实测「idle3→idle2 / idle2→idle1 卡顿」。本配方允许可见的呼吸与重心转移（逐帧差目标1.5~2.5，与产线原件一致），让姿势变化摊在整段里完成。其余约束（脚不移动、脸不动、相机固定、衣服背景一致）原样保留。
